metadata.purpose: Adversarial regression near the sampled first-swing boundary for SincroLab.
metadata.adversarial_characteristic: The sampled assessment is STABLE at the tested dt_s values up to 0.1 and UNSTABLE at dt_s = 0.2 for the same model inputs.
metadata.limitation: This case exposes time-step sensitivity; it is not a CCT result or a claim that either coarse trajectory is numerically converged.
